house.description: Motor vehicle sales tax exemption for sale of preowned motor vehicles created.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

additions: Preowned motor vehicles, as defined in section 297B.01, subdivision 13a, that are exempt from taxation under chapter 297B are exempt.
This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2026.

"Preowned motor vehicle" means any motor vehicle that has been previously sold at retail, titled, registered, leased, or otherwise transferred to a person and that has been operated or placed into service prior to the current sale or transfer. For resale purposes, a motor vehicle must be deemed preowned regardless of mileage if it has been previously titled or registered to a person or entity other than a manufacturer, distributor, or dealer licensed under section 168.27.
This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2026.
(17) purchase or use of a preowned motor vehicle
This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2026.
